_comments: Feature Pipeline Rederivation Leases - one lease row per Record Process, the single-flight lock of a Feature
Pipeline run's budgeted re-derivation slice (PR 5 §5.2.4, D5-41). Record-change tracking is off: the row is a
lock renewed every minute by RederivationLease only, and its history is not an audit record. CodeGen's default
for a new table turned tracking on; this record sets ONLY TrackRecordChanges (as .entity-ml-scoring-runs.json
does), so the entity's other attributes stay at their CodeGen values (PR 5 §9 D5-B3-1).
